summary: Frontend-only retest of iteration_53 regressions. All 7 requested features verified on the public URL at 1920x1080: (1) ApiKeyForge is mounted in /dashboard with metadata + permissions panels, per-permission segmented controls, presets, JSON preview, auto-disable toggle; no old single-input key form remains. (2) Key creation returns frb_live_ prefixed key in new-key-banner; Copy works ('Copied'), Test Key returns key-test-results (PASS /llm/models, PASS /audio/tts, FL-403 /agents/run matching selected perms). (3) New key appeared in keys-table and was successfully revoked (row disappeared + 'Key revoked' toast). (4) /studio renders CreativeStudio; video tab -> prompt -> generate produced task RUNNING -> COMPLETED in ~9s with studio-video-player rendered. (5) /visual-studio still renders old Visual Realism Studio. (6) Landing nav tab order matches the exact required order. (7) /database redirects to /auth?mode=login when unauthenticated and renders Database Manager when logged in. Backend was intentionally not retested.

minor.issue: Sample video URLs returned on completion (https://storage.googleapis.com/gtv-videos-bucket/sample/*.mp4) now return HTTP 403 AccessDenied (bucket no longer anonymously readable). The <video> element renders but never loads media (readyState=0, duration=NaN, videoWidth=0) so the 'playable video' is a black frame. Verified working replacements: https://interactive-examples.mdn.mozilla.net/media/cc0-videos/flower.mp4 (200), https://test-videos.co.uk/vids/bigbuckbunny/mp4/h264/720/Big_Buck_Bunny_720_10s_1MB.mp4 (200), https://filesamples.com/samples/video/mp4/sample_640x360.mp4 (200)

ui_bugs.issue: Video player shows a black/blank frame because the backend sample MP4 URL 403s; no error state is shown to the user when the video fails to load (no onError handler on <video>)

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — an <option> element on the dashboard (likely the 'EMAIL ALERT @ 500' select or one of the package/app selects) contains a nested element; should render plain text only

action_items: Replace the 403-ing gtv-videos-bucket sample URLs in server.py (~line 1060) with reachable MP4s (e.g. https://interactive-examples.mdn.mozilla.net/media/cc0-videos/flower.mp4) so the studio video actually plays
Add an onError fallback message on studio-video-player so a failed media load is visible to the user
Fix the <option> containing a <span> on /dashboard to clear the React hydration warning
critical_code_review_comments: CreativeStudio video polling interval is created inside generate() but is never cleared on component unmount — navigating away mid-job leaves a 3s interval running and calls setState on an unmounted component. Store the interval id in a ref and clear it in a useEffect cleanup.
ApiKeyForge sends the full permissions map including no_access entries to POST /api/keys while the JSON preview filters them out — preview and payload diverge (cosmetic but misleading).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows passed (1 media-URL defect found)
